events.verdict: Walker (IND) legally contests Podziemski's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Green (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball, dislodging it from Nesmith (IND) before the incidental follow-through contact with his arm.
Green (GSW) firms up in a screening position when contact occurs with Jackson (IND), and Green absorbs the contact during the pick.
Kuminga (GSW) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Jackson (IND) is established in a legally obtained position before Curry (GSW) makes incidental contact by inadvertently running into him.
Butler III (GSW) brings his off-arm toward Jackson's (IND) side and marginal contact occurs as Butler III attempts to dribble around Jackson during the drive.
Jackson (IND) initiates more-than-marginal contact with Butler III's (GSW) head during the dunk attempt.
Jackson (IND) enters the lane prior to Butler III (GSW) releasing the free throw attempt.
Kuminga (GSW) momentarily rests his hand on Siakam's (IND) body and the contact is marginal as Siakam moves to set his intended pick.
Green (GSW) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Kuminga (GSW) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Green (GSW) is already in Jackson's (IND) path when marginal contact occurs as the two come together during the screen.
Jackson (IND) contests Kuminga's (GSW) jump shot attempt, and as he lands, his heel makes marginal contact with the top of Kuminga's foot.
Jackson (IND) releases his pass while slipping and falling on the perimeter, with no contact initiated by any Warriors defender.
Green (GSW) legally contests Jackson's (IND) shot attempt.
Jackson (IND) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) rests his hand on Hield's (GSW) body and the contact is marginal during the rebound.
